01

Situation

Awareness was never the problem. Every woman in the target group already knew mammograms matter. Knowing it and booking it are separated by dread, not information.

Previous campaigns worked the statistics angle, which is exactly the register that makes people close the tab.

02

Diagnosis

The part that decided everything else. Prospects recognise themselves in constraints, not in triumphs.

Fear-based messaging asks someone to act while feeling their worst. It converts the already-converted and repels everyone else.

The people most likely to bring a friend were not scared, they were proud. Build for them and the reluctant arrive as guests rather than patients.

03

The system

Built in sequence. Each piece assumes the one above it is settled.

01

Campaign platform

Poster Girls as the organising idea — real participants, front and centre, no stock imagery anywhere.

02

Identity

A campaign identity that reads as celebration at fifty feet and information up close.

03

Channel plan

Social, print and partner distribution built around the signup as the single action.

Creative Strategy →Ongoing Marketing →Brand Development →
04

Result

Event signups rose 49% against the prior campaign.
